subject: Pricing & model mix follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing & model mix follow-up

Samir — great chat today, thanks for your time. Quick recap and next steps below.

Call recap:
- Primary use: customer support assistant (chat for agents + async user chat) and semantic search (embeddings) for KB retrieval. We also discussed a smaller reranking flow for search results.
- Expected traffic: peak ~200 qps across flows; baseline throughput ~60 qps.
- Current constraints: need sub-300ms p99 for agent chat; embedding latency can be relaxed.

Open asks for us to price accurately:
1) Rough monthly token volumes by flow (agent chat, user chat, embeddings, rerank) — ballpark is fine.
2) Target budget or target unit economics (e.g., target $/1M tokens) so we can tailor model mix and hosting options.
3) Any compliance/contract constraints we should be aware of (PCI/PHI/retention).

Vivek and Rishi are looped for sizing and recommended model mixes. If you can share ballpark volumes + target $/1M tokens by end of week we’ll send a draft cost model and SOW.

Next steps:
- You: send volume split + any budget bands.
- Us: produce a 2-page cost model (per-model unit economics + 3 scenario outcomes) and an SOW draft.

Thanks — Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood_pricing_template_v1.xlsx (see cost model template)

From: Samir Patel <samir@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & model mix follow-up

Marissa — thanks for the recap. Below are the ballpark numbers I promised on the call (monthly averages):

- Agent chat (high-cost, low-latency): ~120M prompt tokens, ~240M completion tokens
- User chat (end-user-facing, higher volume): ~800M prompt tokens, ~1.6B completion tokens
- Embeddings (KB + semantic search): ~4M embedding units (text-embedding-3-small equivalent)
- Rerank (daily batch reranking): ~200M tokens total

Budget: leadership has given a rough target of $4k–$8k / month initially for hosted API spend while we validate. If unit economics are compelling we can discuss a Dedicated reservation. For planning, we care about ~$1–$5 per 1M tokens (we know this is wide).

Compliance: only standard SOC2; no PHI/PCI in this workload. Retention: 30 days for analytics, 90 days for transcripts (can be negotiated).

Happy to sync with procurement if you need an initial headcount/PO number.

—Samir
Head of ML Ops | BrightLayer
samir@brightlayer.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & model mix follow-up

Thanks Samir — this is very helpful. A few clarifying Qs so we can produce an accurate cost model:

1) For the chat flows, are the prompt/completion splits per-turn (i.e., prompt tokens are average per request) or aggregated monthly totals (you listed aggregated totals which is fine; just confirming).
2) For embeddings, is the 4M units a per-month embed request count (i.e., one embedding call per doc) or a units estimate post-dedup?

Preliminary notes (so you have expectations):
- With the volumes you shared, hosted API at incumbent pricing will likely be >$Xk/mo (we'll compute exactly). To get into your stated $4k–$8k band we would likely recommend a model mix that leans on 8-bit/quantized variants for user chat and uses a cheaper embedding SKU plus aggressive prefix caching for agent chat.
- Target $/1M tokens: can you share whether the leadership target is strict (hard cap) or a test budget for PoC? That will change whether we propose Dedicated or hybrid routing.

Could you confirm the two clarifying points above? If yes, we’ll turn around a 2-scenario cost sheet (hosted vs. dedicated) plus a recommended model mix and expected p99 latency for agent chat.

If easier, I can hop on a 20-min call with Vivek + Rishi to walk through the assumptions.

—Marissa

From: Samir Patel <samir@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@brightlayer.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & model mix follow-up

Marissa — quick answers:
1) The prompt/completion numbers I gave are aggregated monthly totals (not per-turn averages). Per-turn averages: prompt ~1200 tokens, completion ~900 tokens for agent chat; user chat prompt ~450 tokens / completion ~700 tokens.
2) Embeddings: 4M is post-dedup monthly embed calls (predictable).

Budget: the $4k–$8k band is a test/PoC cap for the first 90 days; leadership expects costs to come down after validating results. So please optimize for cost within that first-window.

Model mix (current thinking):
- Agent chat (latency-sensitive): prefer a small family of chat-optimized models for agents; estimate 15% of total token volume will be agent chat.
- User chat (highest volume): will favor cheaper chat models; estimate 65% of token volume here.
- Embeddings: 15% of API calls but small in token terms (we gave units).
- Rerank: 5% of token volume, batched overnight.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call — procurement copied in case we need PO guidance.

—Samir

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@brightlayer.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & model mix follow-up

Perfect — thanks for the clarification and the split. We’ll produce: 
- A redwood_cost_model.xlsx with hosted vs Dedicated scenarios targeted to the $4k–$8k PoC band (showing model mix levers and expected $/1M tokens).
- A short recommendation doc (2 pages) with per-model suggestions (chat_small-quantized for user chat, chat-latency-optimized for agent chat, embed-small for embeddings, rerank-batch for rerank) and expected p99s.

I attached the initial SOW draft and the cost model template for you/ procurement to review. Next step: Vivek will set a 20-min call for Monday to walk the assumptions and choose the final model mix.

Thanks — Marissa

Attachment: BrightLayer_SOW_Draft.pdf; redwood_cost_model.xlsx
